violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Observed open bags of food in south upright freezer in food prep area.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Observed north upright freezer in food prep area needs to be defrosted.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory * was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. - Disposable towels empty in the handwashing station
